title: Verified executive contacts and cold email inboxes

facts: Post requests about 150 verified contacts (founders and CEOs of consumer and subscription companies, lower middle market sell-side bankers and brokers) with name, title, company, LinkedIn URL, verified email and email source; under 3% bounce on verification with report; 2 to 3 inboxes on a secondary domain with SPF, DKIM, DMARC and warm-up in Instantly or Smartlead; short handoff doc; all accounts under the client's ownership.
No client name in the post. 'Margaux' is the required first proposal word, not a verified name. Fallback used: your team.

Clay has no accepted native renderer (02-UI-REFERENCE-GUIDE: reference only, no saved table image). Demo uses the explicitly custom workbench to show the deliverable package and never labels it as Clay or Instantly.

All contacts, companies, domains and LinkedIn URLs are fictional (.example domain). Figures shown are the client's own targets, not past results. No live enrichment, verification, DNS change or warm-up is claimed.

scenes.title: Here's how your list gets built.
scenes.caption: Your criteria go in. A verified list and warmed inboxes come out.
scenes.beat: It starts with your criteria. Clay finds each company and the right person, and I cross-check them on LinkedIn. Every email keeps a note of where it was found. Then every email gets verified, and anything risky comes off the list. Last, I set up two or three inboxes on a separate domain you own, and hand you a short guide.
details: 0:10 to 0:40. Point to each step from left to right, then to the ownership note on the right.
